## History

Jordan went to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) for work, where he fell in love with and married [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Murray. His father subsequently gave him a farm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he built a small house and lived with [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) for four years. Following Hester's death, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P2](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0002), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P4](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0004), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), +40 more_

## Relationships

### [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hester-gray--jordan.md)

Jordan is the husband of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), having married her in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) before the couple relocated to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their life together became the subject of a romantic local story after Hester's passing, leaving behind a forgotten garden in the woods that later travelers would stumble upon. Their shared history in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) remains remembered through the secluded plot of land [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) once tended.

- Spouse of — married in Boston and moved to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)</sub>
